title: acinos hungaricus f. coloratus
intro: Acinos hungaricus f. coloratus, commonly known as Hungarian chamomile, is a plant species in the mint family. It is used in herbal medicine for its calming and soothing effects, providing health benefits such as reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Hungarian chamomile include acting as a mild sedative and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help with insomnia and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
